text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ah, I can hear it. The voice calling out to me.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It seems that in this world as well,
people long for the miracles of a saint.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "For that very reason—Trainer. Please, watch over me to the end."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "For a holy victory! For the Saint's triumph!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...Or so I thought, but colorful mini lights had been set up behind Red Desire."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, with this, the Saint's Departure Rite is complete.
Toward the day we reach "that place"—
I shall hold the shining glory in my hands.
